cell_type_or_model: Inflammatory macrophage and inflammasome-primed cell systems
assay_or_perturbation: ADORA2A stimulation/perturbation; cAMP/PKA; CREB/HIF1A perturbation; IL1B promoter and expression assays
evidence_summary: ADORA2A-linked cAMP/PKA signaling was associated with CREB/HIF1A-dependent IL1B upregulation after inflammatory priming.
limitations: No direct endogenous TF occupancy, source-composite perturbation or SCI receiver validation was established.

assay_or_perturbation: Adenosine/A2 agonism; ADORA2A/ADORA2B perturbation; HIF1A/Sp1 and PFKFB3 promoter assays
evidence_summary: A2-family activation was associated with HIF1A/Sp1-dependent PFKFB3 transcription in an inflammatory-metabolic context.
limitations: A2A/A2B contributions were not fully separable and endogenous adenosine-source perturbation was not matched to the 20B source composite.
